what: item1_coverage: Saunders & DeNeefe (2024) subword vocabulary coverage and word types (WMT2027_PLAN.md 3.2 item 1); descriptive, not a registered result

spm.joint: one model for both sides (dataset.py: self.tokenizer.sp encodes src and tgt)

budgets.pieces_matched_rule: largest multiple of 100,000 below the smallest set's piece count on that side

resampling.what: the R0 rule (RU0 pool) and ft_un_random's rule (UN rows of ft_random) redrawn with seeds [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] at ft_un_div's histogram; draws overlap heavily (same finite pool), so the sd is the draw-to-draw spread of these rules, not sampling error from a population

contrasts.contrast: ft_un_rep vs ft_un_div (E0.5 Q1, E0.6 Q1')
ft_un_div vs ft_un_random (E0.5 Q2, E0.6 Q2')

checks.check: piece types with 1 thread (Python set) = with N threads (bincount), ft_un_rep source

definitions.row: the line as read with LF as the only break (e06_build.py read_lines), then .strip() (dataset.py)
definitions.pieces: sp.encode(line.strip(), out_type=int): spm_enfr_v1_fixed.model defaults, no sampling, no BOS/EOS
definitions.coverage: distinct piece ids over all rows of the set on that side, control and unknown ids excluded, / countable ids (31,996 of one joint 32,000-id en-fr vocabulary): Saunders & DeNeefe's 'share of the generic subword vocabulary that appears at least once', with e06_build_spec.md A28's PROPOSAL for which ids count
definitions.coverage_min_count: share of countable ids occurring at least k times in the set
definitions.coverage_of_side_vocab: the same, with numerator and denominator restricted to the ids the base saw at least once on that side of its pretraining corpus (train.clean.en / .fr, read the same way)
definitions.pretraining_token_share_uncovered_ppm: pretraining piece tokens on that side whose id never occurs in the set, per million (token-weighted coverage = 1 - this / 1e6)
definitions.coverage_at_matched_pieces: coverage among the first N pieces of the rows in a Random(0) shuffle of the set's ascending row list (types_at's rule on pieces); N per side in budgets
definitions.coverage_rows_kept_by_trainer: coverage over the rows dataset.py keeps (both sides non-empty, <= 256 pieces with BOS/EOS)
definitions.source_word_types_D11: distinct lowercased \w+ source tokens over all rows (prereg D11, e05_build.py lexicon)
definitions.source_word_types_at_5600000: distinct source tokens in the first 5,600,000 source tokens, types_at's rule
definitions.french_word_types_at_6500000_D12: prereg D12 (vocab/common.py types_at, Random(0) shuffle of the ascending rows)
definitions.R0 / A_narrow rows: row indices into ft_random in its LF line order (e06_build.py Parent('ft_random'), build_r0, build_a_narrow); checked above
